surfaces.name: openkanban terminal UI (Go, Bubble Tea) with project CLI

claims.answer: Terminal-only client: the openkanban TUI binary for macOS and Linux (Windows archives are built but undocumented); no mobile, browser or editor client.

desktop_os.answer: darwin and linux archives (amd64, arm64) and Homebrew/go install are documented; GoReleaser also builds windows zip archives but README documents macOS/Linux only and Windows PTY behaviour is not established.

mobile_apps.answer: No iOS or Android client. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

browser.answer: No web server or browser UI; the product is a Bubble Tea terminal program. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

mobile_browser.answer: No web interface, so no phone browser access. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

cli.answer: openkanban binary: TUI plus new, list, delete, config validate/generate/path and version subcommands.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

task_actions.answer: Start (n create, space move, s spawn), steer (attach with enter and type into the agent), stop (S) and resume (continuation flags) work in the TUI; approvals happen inside the agent terminal and there is no change-review view.

notifications.answer: Status badges (working/idle/waiting/error) on cards, a working-count header and in-TUI toast notices; no OS, push or mobile notification.

cross_device_continuity.answer: State is local JSON under the config directory and PTYs live in the TUI process, so there is no second-device access.

limitations: Windows release archives are produced but no Windows install or PTY support is documented.
Review of changes and phone/browser access are absent.

claims.answer: Runs any CLI agent in an embedded PTY; defaults for OpenCode, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI and Aider with session-resume handling for four of them; model choice is left to each harness.

scope.harness: opencode, claude, gemini, codex, aider, custom

harnesses.answer: Default agents map has opencode, claude (--dangerously-skip-permissions), gemini (--yolo), codex (--full-auto) and aider (--yes); a ticket picks one.

model_providers.answer: No model or provider setting in OpenKanban; each harness selects its own models (config.go has no model fields).

custom_adapters.answer: agents.<name> accepts any command, args, env and init_prompt; resume handling is built in only for claude, opencode, gemini and codex.

session_integration.answer: Launches the harness terminal command in an embedded PTY (creack/pty + vt10x); only OpenCode additionally gets a local `opencode serve` HTTP status integration. No harness API embedding.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: Ticket.AgentType is per ticket and the form lists configured agents, so tickets on one board can run different harnesses concurrently (up to the PTY panes the user spawns).

limitations: Parts that are partial, unsupported or unknown in the scoped release: model_providers; see the atomic answers.

claims.answer: OpenKanban has no accounts or credit system; it runs the vendor CLIs unchanged, so their own logins or API keys apply, except that CLAUDE_*, OPENCODE_*, GEMINI_* and CODEX_* environment variables are stripped.

agent_subscriptions.answer: Subscription logins are not managed or documented by OpenKanban; the harness binary runs with the user HOME and its own stored login, but CLAUDE_*, CODEX_*, GEMINI_* and OPENCODE_* env vars are removed before launch.

api_accounts.answer: Provider keys such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are not filtered and agents.<name>.env can set variables, but no API-account feature or documentation exists.

vendor_credits.answer: OpenKanban sells nothing and has no credits. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

local_models.answer: No local-model integration; aider/opencode could be configured with local models only through their own settings. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

account_switching.answer: No account or profile switching. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

vendor_account_requirement.answer: No OpenKanban account, login or token is needed; only the chosen agent CLI needs its own access.

provider_restrictions.answer: README and docs state no provider restrictions or terms constraints (searched docs and README).

limitations: Parts that are partial, unsupported or unknown in the scoped release: agent_subscriptions, api_accounts, vendor_credits, local_models, account_switching, provider_restrictions; see the atomic answers.

claims.answer: Install via Homebrew or go install, register a git repository with `openkanban new`, create a ticket (n), move it to In Progress (space) and spawn an agent (s); git repositories only.

first_task_setup.answer: Quick Start: cd repo; openkanban new "My App"; openkanban; then n, space, s, enter.

no_git.answer: CreateProject returns "not a git repository" when .git is missing, so a directory without Git cannot be registered.

local_git_without_remote.answer: Worktrees branch from the default branch resolved from origin/HEAD or local main/master; no remote is required.

hosted_git.answer: A repo with a GitHub remote is an ordinary registered repo; OpenKanban makes no GitHub API calls except the release check.

prerequisite_guidance.answer: README gives install and quick start; the need for git and an installed agent CLI is implicit (agent not configured notice, git errors) rather than documented.

managed_cloud_setup.answer: No managed cloud. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

byo_vps_onboarding.answer: No remote host or VPS installer. Bounded search of the pinned source found no implementation.

limitations: Parts that are partial, unsupported or unknown in the scoped release: no_git, prerequisite_guidance, managed_cloud_setup, byo_vps_onboarding; see the atomic answers.

operations.answer: Create/list/delete project and validate config from the CLI; no create, inspect, steer, stop or review of tickets outside the TUI.

authentication.answer: No remote interface exists, so no authentication scheme.

stability.answer: Version 0.1.x with no stated stability or deprecation policy in README or docs; config is schema-validated at load.

revisions.answer: Tickets store only CreatedAt/UpdatedAt; no revision history.

stop.answer: S stops the agent (Process.Kill); quitting stops all after confirmation.

steer.answer: Enter attaches to the PTY and passes all keys except ctrl+g to the agent.

evidence.title: OpenKanban README
evidence.finding: TUI kanban board; each ticket gets its own git worktree and embedded terminal; agents OpenCode, Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, Aider or any CLI; multi-project; Homebrew and go install; AGPL-3.0.

evidence.title: Configuration guide
evidence.finding: config.json defaults, agents map (command, args, env, init_prompt), branch naming, cleanup, behavior, ui, themes, OpenCode server and Claude status integration via oh-my-claude, labels and priority, keybindings.

evidence.title: Agent integration guide
evidence.finding: Agents run in embedded PTY terminals; spawn requires In Progress; context-prompt injection; session continuation flags; status detection; environment filtering; no input from users reaches the command line.

evidence.title: AGPL-3.0 licence text
evidence.finding: GNU Affero General Public License version 3 text; README and GitHub metadata state AGPL-3.0; no "or any later version" grant added to the README.

evidence.title: Ticket data model
evidence.finding: Ticket has ID, ProjectID, Title, Description, Status backlog/in_progress/done/archived, UseWorktree, WorktreePath, BranchName, BaseBranch, AgentType, AgentStatus, AgentSessionID, timestamps, Labels, Priority, Meta, BlockedBy (comment: informational only, no enforcement).

evidence.title: Default columns
evidence.finding: Three columns Backlog, In Progress (Limit 3) and Done.

evidence.title: Column count and limit rendering
evidence.finding: Column header shows (n/limit) and styles the count when the limit is reached; no enforcement code found elsewhere (grep ".Limit" matches only board.go and view.go).

evidence.title: Ticket store persistence
evidence.finding: Tickets persist as per-project JSON under the config directory tickets/ (atomic tmp+rename write); migration from legacy repo-local .openkanban/tickets.json.

evidence.title: Global ticket store
evidence.finding: GlobalTicketStore aggregates all projects for the single board; blocker reference cleanup on delete.

evidence.title: Root and project commands
evidence.finding: Cobra root runs the TUI (flags --config, --project); subcommands new, list, delete (projects only).

evidence.title: Config subcommands
evidence.finding: config validate, generate, path.

evidence.title: App startup and project creation
evidence.finding: Starts opencode server only when the default agent is opencode; update checker created; CreateProject rejects a path without .git ("not a git repository"); ListProjects counts tickets.

evidence.title: spawnAgent
evidence.finding: Spawn requires the ticket In Progress ("Press Space to move to In Progress first"), blocks a second agent on the same ticket and a second main-repo agent in a project, resolves ticket agent type or default, starts the opencode server on demand.

evidence.title: prepareSpawn
evidence.finding: Creates the worktree (git worktree add) or sets up a branch in the main repo, creates PTY pane in the worktree, injects the context prompt for new sessions, adds --continue/--session/--resume/resume flags for claude, opencode, gemini and codex on later spawns, allocates a per-ticket opencode port.

evidence.title: quickMoveTicket
evidence.finding: Space moves a ticket to the next column and creates the worktree when it first enters In Progress; no dependency or limit check before the move.

evidence.title: Ticket delete cleanup
evidence.finding: Delete stops the pane, optionally removes the worktree (cleanup.delete_worktree) and branch (delete_branch), warns on uncommitted changes unless force_worktree_removal, removes blocker references.

evidence.title: Quit handling
evidence.finding: Quitting with running agents asks for confirmation (behavior.confirm_quit_with_agents) and then stops them.

evidence.title: Cleanup on exit
evidence.finding: Cleanup() gracefully stops every running pane (interrupt then kill after timeout).

evidence.title: Blocker selection UI
evidence.finding: Ticket form field for BlockedBy with filter and sorted candidates; selected blockers saved on the ticket.

evidence.title: Dependency badge
evidence.finding: Card shows blocked-by and blocks counts as a badge.

evidence.title: Search filter
evidence.finding: Search matches title and description, supports @project prefix; project sidebar filter.

evidence.title: Status detection
evidence.finding: Statuses idle/working/waiting/completed/error detected from the OpenCode HTTP API, status files under ~/.cache/openkanban-status and terminal-text pattern matching.

evidence.title: Status file read/write
evidence.finding: Reads and writes JSON status files per session name; stale files cleaned on spawn.

evidence.title: Status polling
evidence.finding: Polls agent statuses on a timer and updates ticket cards; panes that exit are reset.

evidence.title: PTY pane lifecycle
evidence.finding: Starts the agent command under creack/pty in the ticket worktree, vt10x terminal emulation, Stop kills the process, StopGraceful interrupts then kills.

evidence.title: Agent environment
evidence.finding: Strips OPENCODE_*, CLAUDE_*, GEMINI_*, CODEX_* variables, sets TERM and OPENKANBAN_SESSION for the child.

evidence.title: Worktree manager
evidence.finding: git worktree add -b branch path base under <repo>-worktrees; list and remove; default branch from origin/HEAD or main/master.

evidence.title: Branch and status helpers
evidence.finding: GetDefaultBranch, DeleteBranch, SetupBranch, HasUncommittedChanges (git status --porcelain).

evidence.title: Project model
evidence.finding: One project per git repository with worktree dir default <repo>-worktrees and per-project branch settings.

evidence.title: Config structure
evidence.finding: Config sections defaults, agents (command, args, env, status_file, init_prompt), ui, cleanup, behavior, opencode.

evidence.title: Config directory
evidence.finding: OPENKANBAN_CONFIG_DIR, XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config/openkanban.

evidence.title: Effective init prompt
evidence.finding: Agent-specific init_prompt, then defaults.init_prompt, then built-in prompt.

evidence.title: Context prompt builder
evidence.finding: Go text/template with Title, Description, BranchName, BaseBranch, TicketID, Status, WorktreePath.

evidence.title: OpenCode server manager
evidence.finding: Starts opencode serve on the configured port (reusing a running server) and polls its HTTP endpoint.

evidence.title: Update check
evidence.finding: GET https://api.github.com/repos/TechDufus/openkanban/releases/latest on start (skipped for dev builds); shows a notice with the brew or go install hint; no config key to disable.

evidence.title: Update check wiring
evidence.finding: Init() runs checkForUpdates and notifies when a newer release exists.

evidence.title: In-app settings
evidence.finding: Settings menu edits theme, default agent, confirm quit, branch prefix, cleanup flags, sidebar and project filter and writes config.json.

evidence.title: Themes
evidence.finding: Built-in themes catalog.

evidence.title: GoReleaser build matrix
evidence.finding: Builds linux, darwin and windows on amd64 and arm64; tar.gz archives and windows zip; checksums.txt.

evidence.title: CI workflow
evidence.finding: Go build, lint, unit tests, smoke test and integration tests on push and PR to main.

evidence.title: Release workflow
evidence.finding: Tag push v* runs GoReleaser; workflow_dispatch bumps version.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 155 stars at the check; AGPL-3.0 detected; default branch main; last push 2026-06-12; not archived; no homepage.

evidence.title: Release v0.1.1
evidence.finding: v0.1.1 published 2026-06-12 (commit 02201ed, one bug-fix commit); assets: darwin, linux and windows archives for amd64 and arm64 plus checksums.txt; install via Homebrew or go install.

evidence.title: Repository issues
evidence.finding: Open issues #104 (card height clipping), #102 (agent pane index), #95 (text selection in terminal pane); closed feature issue #103 (per-ticket markdown storage and hot reload) is not part of the pinned v0.1.1 source (no markdown storage code found); no roadmap issue.

evidence.title: README demo recording
evidence.finding: First-party vhs recording of the TUI on synthetic tickets (Add user authentication, Setup database schema, Build REST API endpoints) with OpenCode working and idle states.

evidence.title: Bounded search: network, servers, remote clients
evidence.finding: net/http appears only in internal/update/update.go (GitHub releases API), internal/agent/server.go and status.go (HTTP client to a local OpenCode server on localhost); no listener, web server, mobile client, SSH, container, VM, cloud, login or OAuth code.

evidence.title: Bounded search: PR, CI, merge, deploy, diff
evidence.finding: git is used only for worktree add/remove/list, branch create/delete, status --porcelain and default-branch detection; no commit, push, PR, merge, rebase, diff viewer, CI or deploy code. GitHub API used only for the release check.

evidence.title: Bounded search: MCP, plugins, skills, webhooks, scheduling
evidence.finding: No MCP client or server, plugin loader, skill import, webhook, scheduler or cron code; the only timers are render throttling, status polling and notification expiry.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost, tokens, usage, limits
evidence.finding: cost:/tokens: appear only as substrings matched in agent terminal text for status heuristics (status.go); no usage accounting, spend or token limit; timeouts only for HTTP polling and opencode startup (default 10s).

evidence.title: Bounded search: collaboration, roles, approvals, audit
evidence.finding: No multi-user, role, permission, approval gate, audit log or sharing code; state is single-user JSON under the config directory.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry and export/import
evidence.finding: No telemetry or analytics; no export/import command (tickets are plain JSON files under ~/.config/openkanban/tickets).

changes.author: researcher-batch18
changes.summary: Initial full-profile source pass over release v0.1.1 (commit 02201ed): README, docs, release assets and rg searches across cmd/, internal/ui, internal/terminal, internal/agent, internal/git, internal/project, internal/config, internal/update and CI/release workflows, covering all 51 criteria. Screenshot: the existing accepted first-party README demo-recording frame in the manifest was kept.

locations.result: v0.1.1 (2026-06-12) is latest; notes list one bug-fix commit; no future commitments.
Open issues about card height clipping, agent pane index and terminal text selection; one closed feature issue for per-ticket markdown storage; no roadmap or dated announcements.
States custom keybindings are coming soon without a date; not treated as shipped.
No roadmap section; no changelog file in the repository.

gaps: No website, blog or public roadmap exists; the repository homepage field is empty.
